ruleDefinitions.name: Drop Binaries Into Spool Drivers Color Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of suspcious binary files inside the "\windows\system32\spool\drivers\color\" as seen in the blog referenced below

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\color\\\\") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.sys$")))
